name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 12, 2021 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of Proclamation to Lois Sunrich
4B.
Presentation of Proclamation Declaring May 2021 Bike Month
4C.
Presentation by Habitat for Humanity CEO Lori Holt Pfeiler regarding the Status of Affordable Home Projects
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the April 28, 2021 Special Meeting-Closed Session, and the April 28, 2021 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-05-12 Item 08A Minutes - Amended 05-12-21
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Fadhil
Approve the Warrants.
2021-05-12 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Acceptance of the Coast Highway 101 Traffic Signal Painting Project. Contact Person: Engineering Specialist Edgeworth
1) Authorize the filing of the Notice Completion (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) for the subject project; 2) Authorize the release of the payment bond in full upon the recording of the Notice of Completion; 3) Authorize the release of the performance bond in full one (1) year after the recording of the Notice of Completion; and 4) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-32 (Attachment 2 of the agenda report), entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Accepting the Coast Highway 101 Traffic Signal Painting Project” accepting the public improvements for the Coast Highway 101 Traffic Signal Painting Project as complete to the satisfaction of the City.
2021-05-12 Item 08C Coast Hwy 101 Traffic Signal Painting NOC
8D.
Acceptance of the Gardena Road Sidewalk, Via Molena Curb Ramps, and Vulcan Avenue Sidewalk Project (CS18E, CS16C and CS01E). Contact Person: Engineering Specialist Edgeworth
1) Authorize the filing of the Notice of Completion (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) for the subject project; 2) Authorize the release of the payment bond in full upon the recording of the Notice of Completion; 3) Authorize the release of the performance bond in full one (1) year after the recording of the Notice of Completion; and 4) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-31 (Attachment 2 of the agenda report), entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Accepting the Gardena Road Sidewalk, Via Molena Curb Ramps, and Vulcan Avenue Sidewalk Project (CS18E, CS16C and CS01E)” accepting the public improvements for the Gardena Road Sidewalk, Via Molena Curb Ramps, and Vulcan Avenue Sidewalk Project (CS18E, CS16C and CS01E) as complete to the satisfaction of the City.
2021-05-12 Item 08D NOC for Gardena, Via Molena and Vulcan
8E.
Appointment of two Tenant Commissioners to the Housing Authority with terms ending June 1, 2023. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
The Mayor, with approval from the City Council, appoint Lu Mohler and Janice Williams as the two Tenant Commissioners to the Housing Authority with terms ending June 1, 2023.
2021-05-12 Item 08E Housing Authority Tenant Commission Appointments - Redacted
8F.
Ordinance Adding Chapter 1.18 of the Encinitas Municipal Code Regarding Custody and Use of the City Seal, City Logo, and City Insignia. Contact Person: IT Manager Flynn
Conduct first reading and introduce Ordinance 2021-05, entitled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas California Amending Encinitas Municipal Code by Adding Chapter 1.18 Establishing Regulations for Custody and Use of the City Seal, City Logo, and City Insignia.”
2021-05-12 Item 08F Intro Ordinance to Regulate City Seal and Logo
8G.
Introduction of Ordinance 2021-06 establishing a new speed limit on Lake Drive. Contact Person: Engineering Specialist Barr
Introduce Ordinance 2021-06, entitled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Establishing Speed Limit on Lake Drive.” Establishes a new Speed Limit of 35 mph on Lake Drive between Birmingham Drive and Wales Drive.
2021-05-12 Item 08G Lake Dr Speed Limit
8H.
Legislative position letters submitted to Council for ratification. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Ratify the position letters in support of AB 66 (Boerner-Horvath), in opposition of SB 556 (Dodd), in support of SB 612 (Portantino), and in support of SB 765 (Stern).
2021-05-12 Item 08H Legislative Position Letters
8I.
Resolution delegating authority to exercise discretionary approval of designs for public works and public improvement projects to the City Engineer or designee. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Approve Resolution No. 2021-34 delegating authority to exercise discretionary approval of designs for public works and public improvement projects to the City Engineer or designee.
2021-05-12 Item 08I Design Immunity Resolution
8J.
Manchester Avenue Utility Agreements with Caltrans for sewer appurtenance relocation west of Interstate 5 and sewer line relocation east of Interstate 5 as part of the North Coast Corridor Phase 1 Improvements. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Authorize the City Manager or designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute the utility agreements between the City of Encinitas and Caltrans for the relocation of sewer appurtenances west of I-5 and the relocation of the sewer line east of I-5 along Manchester Avenue.
2021-05-12 Item 08J NCC Sewer Relocation Along Manchester Ave
8K.
Establishment of stop signs at multiple locations throughout the City. Contact Person: Engineering Specialist Barr
1) Adopt City Council Resolution 2021-37, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City Encinitas Establishing Stop Signs at Multiple Locations Throughout the City” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution 2021-39, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Approving the Design and Plans for Establishment of Stop Signs at Multiple Locations Throughout the City Pursuant to Government Code Section 830.6” (Attachment 4 of the agenda report).
2021-05-12 Item 08K Establishment of Multiple Stop Signs Citywide
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Public hearing and consideration of Resolution 2021-35 approving a new organics collection rate, franchise fee increase, temporary special fee; and a new public hearing schedule for Consumer Price Index (CPI) adjustments. Contact Person: Management Analyst Stratakis
a) A new organics collection rate, effective June 1, 2021; b) An increase to the franchise fee from five (5) percent to ten (10) percent, effective June 1, 2021; c) A temporary special fee to the monthly residential rate to cover initial organics collection program fees for a period not to exceed 12 months; d) A five-year schedule of fee adjustments to solid waste rates in accordance with the methodology specified in the Franchise Agreement, allowing for annual consideration of Consumer Price Index (CPI) changes on July 1 of each year; and 2) If the final tabulation of written protest votes does not represent a majority of property owners/customers, adopt Resolution 2021-35 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) approving a new organics collection rate, franchise fee increase, temporary special fee, and new public hearing schedule for Consumer Price Index (CPI) adjustments.
2021-05-12 Item 10A Prop 218 Hearing
10B.
License Agreement with BCycle, LLC to operate the North County Coastal Bike Share Pilot Program in the City of Encinitas. Contact Person: CAP Administrator Najera
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a license agreement with BCycle LLC (in substantial form) to operate the North County Coastal Bike Share Pilot Program in the City of Encinitas (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-05-12 Item 10B BCycle License Agreement
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON MAY 19, 2021
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
